name: highergraphen-cli-skill-bundle
description: Provider-neutral package for the current HigherGraphen CLI and skill integration surface.

entrypoints.cargo_command: cargo run -q -p highergraphen-cli -- architecture smoke direct-db-access --format json
entrypoints.test_gap_input_from_git_command: highergraphen test-gap input from-git --base main --head HEAD --format json --output test-gap.input.json
entrypoints.test_gap_input_from_git_cargo_command: cargo run -q -p highergraphen-cli -- test-gap input from-git --base main --head HEAD --format json --output test-gap.input.json
entrypoints.test_gap_cargo_command: cargo run -q -p highergraphen-cli -- test-gap detect --input schemas/inputs/test-gap.input.example.json --format json
entrypoints.semantic_proof_cargo_command: cargo run -q -p highergraphen-cli -- semantic-proof verify --input schemas/inputs/semantic-proof.input.example.json --format json
entrypoints.ddd_review_cargo_command: cargo run -q -p highergraphen-cli -- ddd review --input schemas/inputs/ddd-review.input.example.json --format json
entrypoints.ddd_input_from_case_space_command: highergraphen ddd input from-case-space --case-space examples/casegraphen/ddd/domain-model-design/sales-billing-customer.case.space.json --format json --output ddd-review.input.json
entrypoints.ddd_input_from_case_space_cargo_command: cargo run -q -p highergraphen-cli -- ddd input from-case-space --case-space examples/casegraphen/ddd/domain-model-design/sales-billing-customer.case.space.json --format json --output ddd-review.input.json
